description: EventFabric is a lightweight, flexible, and powerful framework for building applications using the CQRS pattern and Event Sourcing. It provides a simple API, built-in support for EventSourcingDB and OpenTelemetry, and a variety of features to help you build robust and scalable applications.
feature.simple_core_concepts.title: Simple Core Concepts
feature.simple_core_concepts: No clunky and complex OOP or FP design principles. No Framework Magic. Just explicit code.
feature.simple_core_concepts.additional: Compose an application with commands, events, and queries.
feature.command_and_queries.title: Commands and Queries
feature.command_and_queries: The real world doesn't operate in snapshots – instead it operates in actions, events and outcomes.
feature.command_and_queries.additional: EventFabric is a perfect fit for the CQRS pattern. Read more on:
feature.event_sourcing.title: Event Sourcing
feature.event_sourcing: Event sourcing is a powerful pattern that allows you to capture all changes to an application state as a sequence of events.
feature.event_sourcing.additional: EventFabric provides built-in support for EventSourcingDB:
feature.observability.title: Observability Built-in
feature.observability: Observability is crucial for understanding the behavior of your application and diagnosing issues.
feature.observability.additional: EventFabric provides built-in support for OpenTelemetry, allowing you to easily instrument your application and gain insights into its performance and behavior. Learn more about OpenTelemetry:
